metadata.question: Did Lake Menindee, Australia shrink from January 27, 2017 to February 2, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Location: Lake Menindee, Australia (approximately -32.4°, 142.4°) - Dates: January 27, 2017 (T1) vs. February 2, 2019 (T2) - Collection: Landsat 8 (good water detection, 30m resolution) - Method: Calculate water surface area using NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Mask clouds and shadows using QA_PIXEL band - Focus on water pixels (NDWI > 0.3 typically indicates water) - No need to mask water itself; we want to measure it 3. **Logic**: - Extract images closest to both dates - Calculate NDWI to identify water pixels - Count valid water pixels for each date - Compare: If T1_area > T2_area → shrinkage (A: Yes) - If T1_area ≤ T2_area → no shrinkage (B: No) - If no images found → C1 - If no valid pixels after masking → C2 - If calculation fails (NaN/None) → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Lake Menindee, Australia const lakeGeometry = ee.Geometry.Point([142.395, -32.402]).buffer(15000); // Date windows const date1Start = '2017-01-20'; const date1End = '2017-02-03'; const date2Start = '2019-01-26'; const date2End = '2019-02-09'; // Landsat 8 collection with cloud/shadow masking function filterAndMask(startDate, endDate) { let col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeGeometry) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(function(img) { // Cloud and shadow mask using QA_PIXEL const qaPixel = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloud = qaPixel.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0); // Cloud bit const shadow = qaPixel.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0); // Cloud shadow bit const mask = cloud.and(shadow); return img.updateMask(mask); }); return col; } // Get collections const col1 = filterAndMask(date1Start, date1End); const col2 = filterAndMask(date2Start, date2End); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { print('Jan 2017 Images: ' + size1 + ', Feb 2019 Images: ' + size2); print('C1'); return; } // Median composite for each period const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // Calculate NDWI function calcNDWI(img) { const green = img.select('SR_B3'); const nir = img.select('SR_B5'); return nir.subtract(green).divide(nir.add(green)).rename('NDWI'); } const ndwi1 = calcNDWI(img1); const ndwi2 = calcNDWI(img2); // Water detection (NDWI > 0.3) const water1 = ndwi1.gt(0.3).rename('water'); const water2 = ndwi2.gt(0.3).rename('water'); // Count water pixels const count1 = water1.reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.count(), lakeGeometry, 30, null, null, false, 1e9 ).getInfo(); const count2 = water2.reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.count(), lakeGeometry, 30, null, null, false, 1e9 ).getInfo(); const pixels1 = count1.water || 0; const pixels2 = count2.water || 0; print('Jan 2017 Water Pixels: ' + pixels1); print('Feb 2019 Water Pixels: ' + pixels2); if (pixels1 === 0 || pixels2 === 0) { print('C2'); return; } // Calculate area (30m resolution) const area1 = pixels1 * 900 / 1e6; // km² const area2 = pixels2 * 900 / 1e6; // km² print('Jan 2017 Area: ' + area1.toFixed(2) + ' km²'); print('Feb 2019 Area: ' + area2.toFixed(2) + ' km²'); print('Change: ' + (area2 - area1).toFixed(2) + ' km²'); if (area1 > area2) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
